note: Tiers follow research/field/access-reading-comparables-2026-09-18.md section 6D. decisive = a documented marker that this vendor made the decision on this response. transit = the response passed through or was instrumented by the vendor; the refusal may still come from the site's own server. possible = marker known only from third-party reports. source_kind: vendor-doc, third-party, none. A clue never establishes why a request was refused.

clues.label: cf-mitigated: challenge
clues.means: Cloudflare served a challenge page on this response

clues.label: Cloudflare 1xxx error code in the body
clues.means: Cloudflare itself refused the request; the code says which kind of rule

clues.label: block page titled 'Attention Required! | Cloudflare'
clues.means: a Cloudflare-branded block page; the page names the vendor itself. This page usually reflects a rule the site owner set, which a vendor programme would not override

clues.label: x-vercel-mitigated: challenge
clues.means: a Vercel-named mitigation header on the response; the header names the vendor itself. We did not find it in the Vercel documentation we read

clues.key: making sure you're not a bot
clues.label: Anubis interstitial text
clues.means: the open-source Anubis proof-of-work gate, which the site owner runs and configures

clues.label: Anubis asset path in the body
clues.means: the open-source Anubis proof-of-work gate, which the site owner runs and configures

clues.label: cf-ray header
clues.means: the response passed through Cloudflare

clues.label: x-amzn-waf-action header
clues.means: AWS WAF answered with a challenge or CAPTCHA action (HTTP 202 or 405); this is not delivery

clues.label: x-amz-cf-id header
clues.means: the response passed through CloudFront; AWS WAF may or may not be attached

clues.label: Vercel Security Checkpoint page
clues.means: Vercel's firewall served its challenge page, which scripts cannot pass

clues.label: x-vercel-id header
clues.means: the response was served by Vercel

clues.label: Press & Hold block page
clues.means: HUMAN served its block page

clues.label: _px* cookie set
clues.means: the HUMAN sensor is present on this site

clues.label: Incapsula incident ID in the body
clues.means: Imperva served a block page

clues.label: incap_ses cookie set
clues.means: the site is behind Imperva Cloud WAF

clues.label: visid_incap cookie set
clues.means: the site is behind Imperva Cloud WAF

clues.label: datadome cookie set
clues.means: the DataDome module is in the request path

clues.label: x-datadome header
clues.means: reported by third parties as DataDome; not confirmed in vendor documentation

clues.label: server: AkamaiGHost
clues.means: the response was generated by an Akamai edge server; not proof that Bot Manager decided

clues.label: _abck cookie set
clues.means: reported by third parties as Akamai Bot Manager; not confirmed in vendor documentation

clues.label: bm_sz cookie set
clues.means: reported by third parties as Akamai Bot Manager; not confirmed in vendor documentation

clues.label: x-served-by: cache-*
clues.means: commonly set by Fastly; says nothing about who refused

clues.label: x-kpsdk-* header
clues.means: reported by third parties as Kasada; no vendor documentation found

clues.key: the requested url was rejected. please consult with your administrator
clues.label: F5 'requested URL was rejected' page
clues.means: reported as a BIG-IP application-firewall policy block; vendor page not read
